# Unitree sport-state interfaces

Minimal message subset copied byte-for-byte from the local teamgrit-navigation checkout,
`third_party/unitree_msgs/unitree_go/msg`, source commit
`a1058796bbb4760d8b64baf30d62d8f60fb0a3e0`.

The parent `third_party/unitree_msgs/LICENSE` contains the Unitree BSD-3-Clause license.
Only these three interfaces are built; no Unitree controller or publisher is added.
